name: Phone with a GATT browser (BLE central)
description: A phone running a Bluetooth LE browser (nRF Connect, LightBlue): it scans, connects to the peripheral it is told to as the connection's central, and lists its GATT database: services, characteristics, their properties and the values it can read. It reaches the circuit only through the air.

target.doc: The peripheral to connect to: its advertised name or its address (aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff); empty for the first connectable one heard

interval.doc: The connection interval it asks for

outputs.name: gatt
outputs.doc: The GATT database: each service and its characteristics, their properties and the values read

outputs.name: log
outputs.doc: What happened: connecting, the discovery, a disconnection

functional.claims: Scanning the primary advertising channels in turn, a CONNECT_IND T_IFS after the target's ADV_IND (Bluetooth Core 5.4 Vol 6 Part B 2.3.3.1); the connection as its central at 1M: connection events every interval on channel selection algorithm #1, the sequence numbers' acknowledgement and resending, 27-byte payloads with L2CAP's fragmentation, the supervision timeout, a connection not heard from in six intervals failed to be established (0x3E) and tried again (4.5); the slave's feature exchange, version, data length and terminate answered, LL_UNKNOWN_RSP otherwise (5.1); GATT discovery as a client: the MTU exchange, primary services, characteristics, reading the readable ones (Vol 3 Part G 4); indications confirmed; L2CAP parameter update requests rejected; pairing not supported.

electrical.claims: As functional: it has no pins.

sources.title: Bluetooth Core Specification 5.4: Vol 6 Part B (the Link Layer), Vol 3 Part A (L2CAP), Part F (ATT), Part G (GATT)
sources.notes: CONNECT_IND, connection events, channel selection #1, acknowledgement and flow control, the control procedures, L2CAP's fragmentation, ATT's PDUs and GATT's discovery procedures.
